_about: readability ratchet (DISCIPLINES §6): one row per own-code file, score = long40 + long80 + complex10 + complex15 + deep3 + deep4 + cryptic + noWhatLine + emptyCatch + noHeader. A file may score LESS than its row, never more. Lower it with `node tools/readability.cjs --write` (web) / `--repo api --write`; it never raises.
